title: Joseph the joiner
html_source:
“The Song of the Cheerful (but slightly Sarcastic) Jesus” is a poem by Oliver St. John Gogarty. It was written around Christmas of 1904 and was later published in modified form as “The Ballad of Joking Jesus” in James Joyce’s Ulysses. The poem, like many of Oliver Gogarty’s humorous verses, was written for the private amusement of his friends. In the summer of 1905, he sent a copy to James Joyce, then living in Trieste.
Wikipedia
It is quoted in Chapter 1 (lines 882-905) by Buck Mulligan.
